title: UAV Digital Twin — Command Envelope v1.0
description: The immutable contract for every operator command issued to the digital twin (improvement_plan.md §4 Phase 2 & §6). Every command is validated against this schema, authorized against the caller scope, recorded in an immutable audit trail, and idempotent via intent_id.

command_version.description: Schema version of this command envelope. Major version mismatches must be rejected.

command.description: The command action verb to execute.

aircraft_id.description: Target aircraft callsign (e.g. UAV-01, UAV-02) or '*' for fleet-wide command.

intent_id.description: Unique idempotency key (e.g. UUIDv4 or client monotonic sequence). Duplicate intent_ids are rejected without re-executing side effects.

issued_by.description: Identity of the issuing operator, service, or script (e.g. operator-alpha, gcs-console, demo-controller).

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the operator dispatched the command.

params.description: Arbitrary typed key-value parameters specific to the command verb.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature or HMAC digest of the command envelope payload, used for replay protection and non-repudiation.

tenant_id.description: Multi-tenant partition key (defaults to 'default' in single-tenant deployments).
